interpretation: A verified source can be reachable yet not validate a rule, threshold, or authorship claim.
The independence flag is copied from the snapshot; false is not automatically a vendor classification. Inspect the source before interpreting its evidence.
Vendor accuracy reports and independent evaluation must be kept separate. Neither source reachability nor code parity proves rule validity.
Unsupported, unreachable, and unchecked claims do not justify additional default voting signals.
All 46 dictionary rules retain their existing behavior and are explicitly unvalidated as authorship indicators.
scope: Audit of the existing 2026-07-04 verification snapshot, not fresh live verification of 206 sources.
